best_for: Windows developers and admins who need a PostgreSQL 17 server on a PC or Windows Server, set up with a wizard and pgAdmin, and who will stay on 17 for a while.
description:
PostgreSQL is an object-relational database from the PostgreSQL Global Development Group. Its roots go back to the POSTGRES project at the University of California, Berkeley, in 1986.

Version 17 changed a lot under the hood. Its vacuum process uses up to 20 times less memory, and the project says busy servers can see up to twice the write throughput. JSON_TABLE turns JSON data into a regular table you can query. COPY exports large rows up to twice as fast, and its new ON_ERROR option lets an import keep going past bad rows. Logical replication slots now survive a major version upgrade, so subscribers don't have to resync from scratch.

points.title: The EDB installer, not a community build
points.text: The PostgreSQL project links to an interactive installer built and hosted by EDB. It installs the server, pgAdmin for managing databases, and StackBuilder for adding drivers and tools. It can also run silently.

points.title: Free under the PostgreSQL license
points.text: PostgreSQL is open source under its own permissive license. There is no paid edition of the server itself.

points.title: Supported until November 2029
points.text: PostgreSQL 17 first shipped on September 26, 2024. The project supports each major version for five years, and lists November 8, 2029 as the final release date for 17. Newer majors (18 and 19) are already out.

points.title: Minor updates are easy; majors are not
points.text: Going from 17.x to a later 17.x only needs new binaries and a restart. Moving to 18 or 19 needs a dump and reload or `pg_upgrade`, so a major upgrade takes planning.

points.title: Tested on Windows Server
points.text: EDB tests the 17 installer on 64-bit Windows Server 2022 and 2019 and says it should also run on comparable desktop Windows. The listing here is a 64-bit, per-machine installer that needs administrator rights.

points.title: Zip archive for embedding
points.text: If you want Postgres inside your own installer, EDB also offers a zip of the binaries without the setup wizard.

points.title: Windows only here
points.text: This listing is Windows only and keeps 29 versions of 17. On macOS and Linux, install PostgreSQL from the project's download pages or your package manager.
